title: Studio: author a dataset member's synonyms and description in the dataset form (ADR-0149 D1)
body:
domain:spec#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUe9c6YdtNkrzUnMUd

Filing gate: ④ a per-layer child of a coordination card: the Studio authoring half of #31587 (ADR-0149 D7 card 1). The spec seat ruled fork A on #31587 (claim amend 1, 6724438166): PR #31652 declares the keys but leaves `packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.form.ts`, the 10 `platform-objects` metadata-forms bundles and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts` untouched. PR #31652 records the gap as four `omit` rows in `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` (dimensions/measures × `synonyms`/`description`), which this card removes.

Blocked-by: #31587, #31589

- **Business reason:** an admin building a dataset in Studio cannot give a measure its business synonyms (「营收」 → 收入, 销售额) or its plain-language definition; only code authors can. The dataset AI tools (#31589) answer worse for every dataset built in Studio.
- **Reader:** `domain:spec` for `dataset.form.ts` and the reconciliation rows, with the form bundles and the `ui/` zh-CN mirror riding the same PR (the triage audit decides the lane).
- **Done when:** the dataset form offers both row properties for dimensions and measures, the four `omit` rows are gone, and the form gate stays green.
- **Dedupe (open and closed):** `dataset form synonyms`, `dataset.form.ts description`: 0 hits besides #31587.
